slides.idea: Each leaf opens one drawing with its slides
slides.content:
Headline (top-left, large): "Each leaf opens one drawing with its slides"
Left half: a small hand-drawn mind map: a root card, two section cards to its right (the first labelled "The total workflow", the second "Section 2"), short lines for leaves under each.
One leaf is circled in orange, labelled "leaf"; a thick hand-drawn arrow runs from it to the right half.
Right half: a large sketchpad page labelled "one drawing", holding two small slide rectangles labelled "slide 1" and "slide 2", with a red pen mark on slide 2.
Bottom-right sticky note: "Still open: can one slide sit on two leaves?"
Focal point: the arrow from the leaf to the drawing.
slides.notes: Leaning: agreed (s03-D01). Still open: Can one slide sit on two leaves?

slides.idea: Does every leaf need its own drawing?
slides.content:
Headline (top-left, large): "Does every leaf need its own drawing?"
Three option cards across the middle, joined by a wavy line:
 Card A "Every leaf": a tall stack of empty sketchpads with the number "25" on it
 Card B "Only leaves with a slide": one sketchpad with a slide inside
 Card C "On first click", circled in orange with a small tag "leaning": a hand clicking a pencil button labelled "draw", a new sketchpad appearing
Bottom-right sticky note: "Still open: does a red mark start a new pass?"
Focal point: card C.
slides.notes: Leaning: the third (proposal 261029): no empty drawings on disk. Still open: Does a red mark on a drawing start a new pass?
